snippet.title: Caladrius 2/Dark Element - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
A world of dark gothic beauty and shadow.
Over ten years after the mad "Shame Break" system appeared, the forbidden returns!
Distinctive characters, brought to life by top illustrators, charge across a battlefield of darkness!
Element Shot and Shame Break, massively evolved! 2D shooting thrills and sensual visuals, pushed to the limit.
